bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
src=8a804ce5adc3a3ec0f5b0bebb01a18355bbac96e
name=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
git fetch --no-tags origin feat/assistant-ai-and-sales-core >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo STK04_SOURCE_FETCH_FAILED; exit 61; }
git cat-file -e "$src^{commit}" || { echo STK04_SOURCE_COMMIT_MISSING; exit 62; }
target="$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/sticker-poll-$src"
mkdir -p "$target" && chmod 700 "$target"
git archive "$src" | tar -xf - -C "$target"
test -f "$target/src/telegram/stickerWizard.mjs" && test -f "$target/src/runtime/creatorEgress.mjs" && test -f "$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" || { echo STK04_STAGE_INCOMPLETE; exit 63; }
grep -Fq 'sticker:defer' "$target/src/telegram/stickerWizard.mjs" || { echo STK04_STICKER_RECOVERY_NOT_STAGED; exit 64; }
docker inspect "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo STK04_EXISTING_OWNER_CONTAINER_MISSING; exit 65; }
token="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_telegram_token"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$name")"
dbpass="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_db_password"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$name")"
test -f "$token" && test ! -L "$token" && test -f "$dbpass" && test ! -L "$dbpass" || { echo STK04_EXISTING_SECRET_MOUNT_MISSING; exit 66; }
pg="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])postgres([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || { echo STK04_POSTGRES_NOT_UNIQUE; exit 67; }
user="$(docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'printf %s "$POSTGRES_USER"')"
net="$(docker inspect -f '{{range $k,$v := .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{println $k}}{{end}}' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d')"
test -n "$user" && test "$net" = deploy_default || { echo STK04_DB_OWNERSHIP_UNVERIFIED; exit 68; }
other="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei 'create-videobot|createvdobot|videobot-poll|videobot-telegram' | grep -Fxv "$name" || true)"
test -z "$other" || { echo STK04_SECOND_CREATOR_CONSUMER_PRESENT; exit 69; }
log="$(mktemp /tmp/stk04-build.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -f "$log"' EXIT
if ! docker build --network host --pull=false -f "$target/deploy/Dockerfile" -t create-videobot:sticker-recovery "$target" >"$log" 2>&1;then
 echo STK04_IMAGE_BUILD_FAILED
 grep -Ei 'failed|error|unavailable|timeout' "$log" | tail -n 5 | sed -E 's#https?://[^ ]+#URL_REDACTED#g' || true
 exit 70
fi
docker run --rm --network none --pull never --entrypoint node create-videobot:sticker-recovery -e "import('./src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs').then(()=>process.exit(0)).catch(()=>process.exit(1))" >/dev/null || { echo STK04_CANDIDATE_IMPORT_FAILED; exit 71; }
uid="$(docker run --rm --network none --pull never --entrypoint id create-videobot:sticker-recovery -u)"
test "$(stat -c '%u' "$token")" = "$uid" && test "$(stat -c '%u' "$dbpass")" = "$uid" || { echo STK04_SECRET_USER_MISMATCH; exit 72; }
export VIDEOBOT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN_SOURCE="$token" VIDEOBOT_DB_PASSWORD_SOURCE="$dbpass" GSERVER_POSTGRES_USER="$user" GSERVER_POSTGRES_NETWORK="$net"
docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" config --quiet || { echo STK04_COMPOSE_INVALID; exit 73; }
docker image tag create-videobot:local-poll create-videobot:poll-rollback
docker image tag create-videobot:sticker-recovery create-videobot:local-poll
if ! docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" up -d --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll >/dev/null 2>&1;then
 echo STK04_POLL_RECREATE_FAILED
 docker image tag create-videobot:poll-rollback create-videobot:local-poll
 docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" up -d --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 exit 74
fi
sleep 11
if test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null)" != true || ! docker logs --tail 120 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -q '^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$';then
 echo STK04_RECOVERY_READY_FAILED
 docker logs --tail 120 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -E '^CREATOR_[A-Z_]+(=|$)' | tail -n 6 || true
 docker image tag create-videobot:poll-rollback create-videobot:local-poll
 docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" up -d --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 echo STK04_PREVIOUS_IMAGE_RESTORATION_ATTEMPTED
 exit 75
fi
echo STK04_CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS
echo STK04_STICKER_RECOVERY_SOURCE_SHA="$src"
docker logs --tail 100 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -E '^CREATOR_(DM|GATE|POLL)_' | tail -n 7 || true
